description: Unit test class for the GlobalEventRegistry in the Eclipse Ditto project, testing JSON parsing, immutability, and exception handling.

classes.name: GlobalEventRegistryTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing `GlobalEventRegistry` functionalities including parsing and immutability.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes test fixture with a singleton instance of `GlobalEventRegistry` and sets up headers and test type.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests if `GlobalEventRegistry` class instances are immutable.

methods.name: globalEventRegistryKnowsJsonTypeTestEvent
methods.description: Verifies that the registry contains the test event type.

methods.name: globalEventRegistryParsesTestJsonObject
methods.description: Tests parsing of a JSON object into a `TestEvent` instance.

methods.name: globalEventRegistryWrapsExceptionInDittoJsonException
methods.description: Ensures that parsing throws a `DittoJsonException` when expected.

methods.name: globalEventRegistryThrowsJsonTypeNotParsableException
methods.description: Checks that an invalid JSON type triggers `JsonTypeNotParsableException`.
